[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads T test cases and, for each (N, K), simulates the Bathroom Stalls interval-splitting process with a max-heap of interval lengths and a multiplicity map to determine the K-th person's interval, printing the final left and right gap sizes." solve]

    [END_INPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create a Scanner named cin reading from System.in. RESULT cin]
            [COMMAND Read the next integer token from cin into int T. RESULT T]
            [COMMAND Start a for loop with int C = 1; continue while C <= T; increment C by 1 after each iteration. RESULT C]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over C, read the next long token from cin into long N. RESULT N]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over C, read the next long token from cin into long K. RESULT K]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over C, create an empty PriorityQueue<Long> named queue, representing a max-heap by storing negative interval lengths. RESULT queue]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over C, create an empty HashMap<Long, Long> named count mapping interval lengths to multiplicities. RESULT count]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over C, add -N to queue and put N -> 1L in count to initialize the single interval of length N. RESULT queue, count]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over C, initialize long ans to 0. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over C, start an infinite while loop that will terminate via break. RESULT while_loop]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, poll the smallest negative value from queue, negate it, and store it in long cur as the current largest interval length. RESULT cur]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, obtain long rest from count.get(cur) as the number of intervals of length cur. RESULT rest]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, if K <= 1, set ans = cur and break out of the while loop. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, subtract rest from K. RESULT K]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, if K <= 0, set ans = cur and break out of the while loop. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, compute long large = cur / 2 and long small = (cur - 1) / 2 using integer division. RESULT large, small]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, if count contains large, add rest to count[large]; otherwise add -large to queue and set count[large] = rest. RESULT queue, count]
            [COMMAND Within the while loop, if count contains small, add rest to count[small]; otherwise add -small to queue and set count[small] = rest. RESULT queue, count]
            [COMMAND After the while loop terminates within the C iteration, print a line of the form 'Case #' + C + ': ' + (ans / 2) + ' ' + ((ans - 1) / 2). RESULT printed_line]
            [COMMAND After all test cases have been processed, close cin. RESULT cin_closed]

    [END_MAIN_FLOW]
